body:
Compare order-list and order-detail application tasks on SQLite and MariaDB. Approved public seams: list_orders(customer_id, cursor, limit), get_order(order_id), and an observation runner recording executed SQL, query counts, and usability after session/transaction closure.

Specification is the oracle. Cover empty orders, shared products, multiple items, tied sort keys, missing detail, distinct complete paginated orders, integer-cent totals, and detached results. Compare explicit snekql joins/batched reads with SQLAlchemy eager loading. Treat naive N+1 loading as a diagnostic. Use isolated real databases, test-first implementation, retained evidence, and a separate unmerged research PR. No package fixes.
title: Research related-data loading and pagination versus SQLAlchemy
